correctness.rationale: For p_z=S_z-S_{z+1}, under alpha=eps*a, theta=eps*b, exact one-step hazard eps(a+c r^z) with r=e^mu>1, c=b(r-1)/mu>0, so fixed-index p_z=eps(a+c r^z)+O(eps²); the log-concavity determinant has leading term -eps²*a*c*r^(z-1)*(r-1)^2<0. For each fixed m the finite intersection of small-eps intervals proves strict log-CONVEXITY on indices 1..m; this does NOT assert a uniform infinite-prefix eps. Independent 65-digit decimal calculations from S_z=exp(-.01(z+2^z-1)) yielded p0=.01980132669, p1=.02896924881, p2=.04639200646, determinant=-.0000794058995773977, ratio=.91355988721917, verifying a genuine counterexample to the unrestricted theorem. Source checker inspected but the asymptotic is the proof, not numerical evidence.
